headline: Bitcoin Fell 2.2 Percent to 82k While the S&P 500 Dropped 1.09 Percent
narrative: Bitcoin changed hands near 82k, down 2.2 percent, money leaving the crypto pipe. The S&P 500 fell 1.09 percent to 7,720.7, the equity pipe selling with bitcoin. Gold fell 1.9 percent to 4,098.1 and silver fell 5.7 percent to 55.79, while oil rose 1.41 percent to 95.47, the energy pipe taking the bid the rest gave up.
